headline: ITD's 17.65% rally and 36.8σ volume spike, alongside an unusually heavy CONMAT tape and fresh ECM-style moves, dominate the morning brief.
market_take: Coverage is heavily skewed toward CONS and CONMAT today, with ITD leading on both price (+17.65%) and an extreme volume spike (36.8σ), coinciding with the 2026-10-02 resignation of its President (manager change). CONMAT breadth is the second notable signal: SCC, EPG, VNG, WINDOW and GEL all triggered alerts, while GEL whipsawed -20.00% open gap then +25.00% intraday. PF and PROP show divergent moves (PF -20.00%, KC +50.00% off a -33.33% gap) and a string of debentureholder-meeting filings for PF and EVER's -28.6% 5-day slide warrant caution. AGRI attention centers on SMO (3.7σ spike + Chair resignation) and STA (5.1σ, +5.88%).

sector_notes.note: ITD's +17.65%/36.8σ spike aligns with the 2026-10-02 President resignation filing; PLE and EMC cap intraday losses of -16.67% and -50.00%, with EMC also printing a +100.00% open gap (highly volatile).

Five alerts in one sector: WINDOW 9.9σ, EPG 5.6σ (+4.76%), VNG 5.4σ, SCC 4.6σ (+6.00%), and GEL with a -20.00% gap followed by a +25.00% intraday rebound; DCON down 15.8% over 5 days with an AGM/EV-related filing.
Mixed picture: CGD +11.11% and WHA +3.77% (9.4σ) on the upside, EVER -16.67%/-28.6% 5D and PF -20.00% on the downside; KC swung +50.00% intraday after a -33.33% open gap.
MNRF +3.96% on thin volume (vol×0.04); quiet elsewhere aside from ALLY's 2026-10-02 capital change filing.
STA +5.88% with a 5.1σ volume spike; SMO triggered a 3.7σ alert the same day as its 2026-10-01 Chairman resignation filing.
TKN has filed six repurchase/buyback notices between 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-07, with the share-repurchase project now completed per the 2026-10-07 notice.
